summary.business_type: Managed IT Services (Service-area business, nationwide with Texas focus)
top_findings: Sitemap references 4 non-existent pages + 5 invalid fragment URLs
managed-it.html Service schema uses placeholder data (novatech.example)
No canonical tags on any page
Linked pages return 404 (privacy.html, web-design.html, about.html, cybersecurity.html, cloud.html)
Domain has zero rankings, zero keywords, spam score 58
managed-it.html is thin content (427 vs 800 minimum)
Content-Signal missing from named robots.txt groups
No llms.txt, no Markdown delivery, no WebMCP tools
quick_wins: Add Organization + Service schema to homepage
Fix managed-it.html schema with real data
Add canonical tags to all pages
Add Content-Signal to named robots.txt groups
Fix empty alt text on managed-it.html

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-rendered static site (959 words without JS)

findings.title: Sitemap has 404 URLs and fragment URLs
findings.description: Sitemap references web-design.html, cybersecurity.html, cloud.html, privacy.html (all 404) and 5 fragment URLs (#services, #process, #why, #faq, #contact) which are invalid in sitemaps.
findings.recommendation: Remove non-existent pages and fragment URLs. Keep only homepage, managed-it.html, and privacy.html (to be created). Remove deprecated changefreq/priority tags.

findings.title: Missing canonical tags
findings.description: No self-referencing canonical tags on index.html or managed-it.html. Risk of duplicate content from fragments or parameters.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://novatechsoft.info/"> to index.html and <link rel="canonical" href="https://novatechsoft.info/managed-it.html"> to managed-it.html

findings.title: Security headers missing
findings.description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, or Referrer-Policy headers.
findings.recommendation: Add security headers via Cloudflare Workers or _headers file for GitHub Pages.

findings.title: Content-Signal only in wildcard robots.txt group
findings.description: Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference only in * group. Named AI groups (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.) don't inherit it per RFC 9309.
findings.recommendation: Repeat Content-Signal line inside each named user-agent group in robots.txt.

findings.title: Linked pages return 404
findings.description: privacy.html, web-design.html, about.html linked from managed-it.html and footer but return 404.
findings.recommendation: Create privacy.html page. Remove or create web-design.html and about.html, or update links.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage meets word count (815 vs 500 minimum)

findings.title: managed-it.html is thin content (427 words)
findings.description: Service page has only 427 words vs 800 minimum. 53% below threshold. Lacks Texas-specific depth, case studies, original data.
findings.recommendation: Expand to 800+ words with Texas-specific content, local case studies, compliance details, and unique value propositions.

findings.title: No author bylines or E-E-A-T signals
findings.description: Zero author attribution on any page. Managed IT is YMYL-adjacent; author credentials required for trust.
findings.recommendation: Add author bio with Person schema. Include credentials, certifications, LinkedIn. Add publication/last-updated dates.

findings.title: Empty alt text on images
findings.description: 3 Microsoft SVG icons on managed-it.html have empty alt attributes.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text: 'Microsoft partner badge', 'Microsoft 365 management', 'Azure cloud services'.

findings.title: Low AI citability
findings.description: No self-contained answer blocks, no statistics with sources, no definitions in first 60 words, no author/entity attribution.
findings.recommendation: Add 'What is managed IT?' definition in first 60 words. Create ~130-170 word self-contained answer blocks per section. Add specific statistics with citations.

findings.title: No internal linking strategy
findings.description: Only navigation links exist. No contextual links between homepage and service page, or to future content.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 contextual internal links per 1000 words. Link from homepage to managed-it.html with descriptive anchor text.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: managed-it.html has Service schema structure (but invalid data)

findings.title: Homepage has zero schema markup
findings.description: No Organization, Service, WebSite, or BreadcrumbList schema on homepage.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization, Service, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to homepage <head>.

findings.title: managed-it.html schema uses placeholder data
findings.description: Service schema contains novatech.example URLs, placeholder phone/email. areaServed only 4 Texas cities (business is nationwide).
findings.recommendation: Replace all placeholder data with real values. Expand areaServed to US nationwide. Add AggregateRating, Offer array for 3 tiers, QAPage for FAQ.

findings.title: Missing QAPage schema on FAQ sections
findings.description: Both pages have FAQ content but no QAPage schema (FAQPage retired but QAPage valid).
findings.recommendation: Add QAPage schema with Question/Answer pairs for each FAQ item.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Static site on GitHub Pages + Cloudflare CDN

findings.title: No CrUX field data
findings.description: Site below traffic threshold for CrUX. CWV scores estimated from lab only.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights when traffic increases. Enable Brotli on Cloudflare. Combine CSS files.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Search crawlers allowed (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot)
Training crawlers blocked (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot)

findings.title: Zero brand mention presence
findings.description: No Wikipedia, Reddit, YouTube, LinkedIn, or industry directory presence. Brand mentions correlate 3x more with AI visibility than backlinks.
findings.recommendation: Create Wikipedia/Wikidata entry. Build YouTube channel. Earn Reddit mentions. Submit to Clutch, G2, Capterra.

findings.title: Content-Signal missing from named AI groups
findings.description: Training vs search preferences not communicated to named crawler groups.
findings.recommendation: Add Content-Signal to each named user-agent group in robots.txt.

findings.title: No llms.txt or Markdown delivery
findings.description: Optional for Google (explicitly ignored), may help other AI crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Create /llms.txt with site map and key facts. Add Accept: text/markdown negotiation.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All homepage images have descriptive alt text

findings.title: 3 images with empty alt text on managed-it.html
findings.description: Microsoft SVG icons (×3) have empty alt attributes.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text for each icon.

findings.title: No WebP/AVIF formats
findings.description: Images served as JPG/SVG only. No modern format optimization.
findings.recommendation: Convert photos to WebP/AVIF with JPEG fallback. Use Cloudflare Polish or build-time conversion.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix sitemap.xml - remove 404 URLs, fragment URLs, deprecated tags
Add canonical tags to index.html and managed-it.html
Add Organization + Service + WebSite + BreadcrumbList schema to homepage
Fix managed-it.html Service schema with real data (replace placeholders)
Add Content-Signal to named robots.txt groups
Fix empty alt text on managed-it.html Microsoft icons
Create privacy.html page

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Expand managed-it.html to 800+ words with Texas-specific content
Add author bio + Person schema to service pages
Add publication/last-updated dates to all pages
Create llms.txt for non-Google AI crawlers
Add QAPage schema to FAQ sections on both pages
Add BreadcrumbList schema to managed-it.html
Add contextual internal links between pages
Optimize images: WebP/AVIF, add dimensions

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Publish 3 case studies with original data and metrics
Create location pages for top 10 metro areas
Build YouTube channel with onboarding/security content
Earn 10+ quality backlinks (partnerships, industry directories)
Submit to Clutch, G2, Capterra, SoftwareAdvice
Create Wikipedia/Wikidata entry for Novatech

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Track keyword rankings (managed IT services, managed IT Texas, vCIO services)
Monitor AI citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews, AI Mode)
Check backlink profile for new toxic links monthly
Quarterly content freshness updates
Run technical audit after each deployment
